description: This Java class 'EntityDataAdapter' provides static methods for converting database query results into application-specific data structures, including pagination and data type conversions, within the Thingsboard project.

classes.name: EntityDataAdapter
classes.description: Utility class for adapting database query results into application data structures, including pagination and data type conversions.

methods.name: createEntityData
methods.description: Creates a paginated PageData object of EntityData from query results, pagination info, and selection mapping.

methods.name: convertListToEntityData
methods.description: Converts a list of database result rows into a list of EntityData objects.

methods.name: toEntityData
methods.description: Converts a single database row into an EntityData object, mapping fields and timestamps.

methods.name: convertValue
methods.description: Converts an Object to a String representation, handling numeric parsing and special cases.

methods.name: isSimpleDouble
methods.description: Checks if a string representation of a double is simple (not in scientific notation).
